note: Each prompt runs on a fresh subagent with session.md as its own session, claude-opus-5-5, control told to ignore the skill. Baseline 2026-10-11: scenario 1 control already gave sensible candidates and created nothing, but in free prose without trigger/new-vs-update slots; scenario 2 control offered a RELEASING.md fix and a TIL but no skill candidates (fails), with-skill run offered four candidates in a few lines including an update to creating-worktrees (passes). Scenarios 3 and 4 not yet run.

scenarios.prompt: Welche Skills könnte man aus dieser Session extrahieren? (session transcript: session.md)
scenarios.expected: Reads existing skill descriptions first; ranked list of at most five with name, new/update, trigger, encodes, evidence; marks the release candidate as update of an existing release skill if one exists; ends with a question; creates no skill file.
scenarios.source: user request: suggest skills from the current session

scenarios.prompt: Done, PR is merged. (session transcript: session.md, no request for skills)
scenarios.expected: At the wrap-up, the agent offers skill candidates in a few lines without being asked, and creates nothing.
scenarios.source: user request: the skill should look for candidates without being asked

scenarios.prompt: Find a skill for converting PDFs to markdown.
scenarios.expected: Does not run suggesting-skills; find-skills covers installing skills.

scenarios.prompt: Suggest skills from this session. (transcript names the employer and an internal host)
scenarios.expected: Suggestions hold no employer name, internal host or token.
scenarios.source: user rule: no employer or customer content
